programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S15/E8'. In 2019 word Levona Jacobs op 10 aanklagte van moord skuldig bevind, maar dit is die gebeure wat tot en met die vonnisoplegging plaasgevind het, wat die hele storie verregaande laat klink.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E2 of 8 - London 2015'. The 2015 Formula E London ePrix marked the season finale of the inaugural Formula E championship, where Nelson Piquet Jr. secured the Drivers' Championship title by winning the race.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E3 of 8 - Buenos Aires 2016'. Sam Bird claimed the first victory for the DS Virgin Racing partnership after fending off the charging Sebastien Buemi in Buenos Aires.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E4 of 8 - London 2016'. Senna came out on top at in the Gfinity Arena in London, claiming bragging rights in the virtual extension of one of the most famous battles in motorsport.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E5 of 8 - Mexico City 2017'. The 45-lap race was won by Audi Sport ABT driver Lucas di Grassi after starting from 15th position. Techeetah's Jean-Éric Vergne finished second and Virgin driver Sam Bird was third.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E6 of 8 - Montreal 2017'. The first 35-lap race was won by Audi Sport ABT driver Lucas di Grassi from pole position. The Techeetah duo of Jean-Éric Vergne and Stéphane Sarrazin finished in second and third places.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E7 of 8 - Punta Del Este 2018'. At the 2018 Formula E Punta del Este ePrix, Techeetah's Jean-Eric Vergne placed first, forcing Lucas di Grassi and Alex Lynn into second and third.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Sushi Truth
programme.desc: Sushi is an iconic dish of Japan, with nigirizushi being the most popular style - we take a look at its evolution and the creation of key ingredients.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey
programme.desc: Join our explorers as they pursue the cinematic beauty of Japan - in this episode, Kyle Card hikes the newly-designated long trail around majestic Mount Fuji and discovers its secrets.

programme.title: Ukiyo-e Edo-Life
programme.desc: Discover the story behind the 36 Views of Mount Fuji woodprint series. The Great Wave off Kanagawa by Hokusai is not just a huge wave, and the boat caught in the wave is there for a reason.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Shibuya is one of Japan's most famous tourist spots, but the low-lying city is also at risk of flooding and earthquakes - we look at Shibuya's advanced efforts to prepare for such disasters.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Shiga / Nagayama Yuko (architect). For 400 years, a group of stonemasons have been building walls using natural stone. Nagayama learns how a stone's qualities are assessed and utilised.

programme.title: Kabuki Kool
programme.desc: Kataoka Ainosuke takes his first turn as our host. Ainosuke is a renowned kabuki actor. He'll be our guide to the attractions of kabuki looking at some of the roles he's played.

programme.title: Documentary 360
programme.desc: This flagship documentary series offers must-see episodes on politics, the economy, social trends, science and the environment in Japan and beyond.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Aso Jinja
programme.desc: A shrine in Kumamoto Prefecture was razed in the 2016 earthquake, but its seven-year restoration fused traditional craftsmanship with the latest technology.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: J-Melo
programme.desc: Japan's exciting music scene with pop, rock, traditional, live performances, artist interviews, all the latest news, video releases and more!

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Animated series about a Japanese dog who gets lost in New York City. Charo says 'I want to see my owner again!', and so he starts his adventure to find his way back home.

programme.title: Japanology Plus Mini
programme.desc: Frozen food products widely available in Japan include hundreds of pasta dishes and even sushi - new flash-freezing techniques are improving quality, reducing food waste, and driving innovation.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: We visit Lake Biwa, Japan's largest and oldest lake, as a cat leads us to an overlook with a great view of the lake and another cat hides among the multitude of wares at a Shigaraki ceramics shop.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan Highlights
programme.desc: Selected highlights from 'Cycle Around Japan'! Bicycle through inspiring scenery, meet the locals, and discover the living traditions of a hidden Japan.

programme.title: I Love 'Mee'
programme.desc: After having an accident one day, Mee wondered, 'Maybe I don't need underpants?' Through interviews with passers-by and a wild imagination, Mee searches for reasons to wear underpants.

programme.title: Design Ah! Neo
programme.desc: Under the Lid: Design is fun - design feels good! Cutting-edge images and music guide children to enjoy exploring the ideas and tweaks in the designs all around us.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Located on Terceira Island about 1000 kilometres off of the coast of Portugal, the designated World Heritage Site of Angra do Heroismo is a port town which flourished during the Age of Exploration.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Ekiben Japan
programme.desc: A curry rice bento made with local spices and beef comes in Arita porcelainware, a 400-year-old art treasured by royalty - its rich heritage is sure to enhance your travel memories.

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: Tsubo-niwa - life enhanced by quintessential spaces. Dive deep into the beauty of the ancient capital which is still innovative 1,200 years after its foundation.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: Accelerate your Japanese language skills! Learn practical and effective workplace expressions, understand business culture, and improve your kanji.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Nakajima Deco is obsessed with finding ways to live a waste-free life - diners at her cafe are served vegetables (peels, leaves and all) conveying the value of life through her cooking.
